paragraphs: A student of R' Ami. Seder HaDorot's author writes, “I have not found it.” Hyman explains that this is a printing error and should read bar Radifa, as in Yuchasin; see his entry.[^1]

notes.text: סה״ד is contextually Seder HaDorot, not Sefer, and Yuchasin the supplied short title, without author/edition identity. I-have-not-found is the quoted author’s observation with an implicit object neutrally it, not this reviewer’s search. Hyman explicitly says printing error (טעות הדפוס), distinct from an automatic ט״ס gloss; his Chifa-to-Radifa correction and reported Yuchasin support remain claims, not verified history. The entry target is naturally Radifa-related but is not newly resolved or linked. Both abbreviated personal titles remain R'.
